stories.title: 3 dead in mass shooting in Seattle. And, U.S. and Iran pause fighting
stories.description: A mass shooting at a Seattle festival has left three people dead. And, the U.S. and Iran have been exchanging diplomatic messages after nearly tw weeks of intense fighting.

stories.title: Can the U.S. and Iran take the off-ramp?
stories.description: The U.S. military has paused its airstrikes on Iran after nearly two weeks of intensifying bombing, while diplomatic efforts have pushed forward to try to avert a return to all-out war.

stories.title: U.S. pauses attacks on Iran for a second straight day and Tehran does too
stories.description: The United States paused attacks on Iran for a second straight day Sunday and Tehran said it had done so too, as efforts continued to bring the countries back to negotiations on an interim ceasefire.

stories.title: Lebanese displaced by war turn to satellites to check their homes
